136:t_004:14.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Come on... You should've figured that much out, best buddy.」

136:t_004:15.en:
$$カトル$$
「We were simply playing along with $$ゼロ$$'s act.」

136:t_004:16.en:
$$トロワ$$
「We improvised it, so it was a bit strained.」

136:t_004:17.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「But you both acted well, $$カトル$$ and $$トロワ$$.」

136:t_004:18.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Indeed. Our self-proclaimed master strategist let his guard down completely.」

136:t_004:19.en:
$$ギルター$$
「D-Damn you! I knew that all along!」

136:t_004:21.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I should mention that all the Federation troop data I gave you was fake.」

136:t_004:23.en:
$$トロワ$$
「You said you knew all along, but your emotions betray you.」

136:t_004:24.en:
$$デュオ$$
「$$ゼロ$$ was right. He said anyone who attacked $$トウキョウ$$ would be a small fry trying to look smart.」

136:t_004:25.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Y-You...! Are you saying you fabricated that data in so little time?!」

136:t_004:26.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Once you fell for my plan, I knew your limits. I merely prepared a scenario to match them.」

136:t_004:27.en:
$$玉城$$
「So you'd set everything up beforehand...?!」

136:t_004:28.en:
$$デュオ$$
「It's been a while since you showed us your magic tricks, $$ゼロ$$.」

136:t_004:29.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「This hardly qualifies as a trick.」

136:t_004:31.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Shut up! Even if I did let my guard down a little, I will never lose to the likes of you!」

136:t_004:32.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ギルター・ベローネ$$! The outcome has already been decided!」

136:t_004:33.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Your arrogance let me lure you into my stalling tactic! Thanks to you, every condition has been met!」

136:t_005:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, $$ゼロ$$, everyone! I've brought reinforcements!」

136:t_005:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「Whew... We made it in time somehow.」

136:t_005:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I've been briefed on the situation, $$ゼロ$$.」

136:t_005:5.en:
$n
「That man $$ギルター$$... $$ゼロ$$ was just playing him like a puppet.」

136:t_005:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Heh... You're as mean as ever, $$ゼロ$$.」

136:t_005:7.en:
$$スザク$$
「But there's no one more reassuring to have on your side.」

136:t_005:8.en:
$$ギルター$$
「$$ゼロ$$! Don't underestimate me! I, $$ギルター・ベローネ$$, have a trump card prepared too!」

136:t_005:9.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I'll deploy every $$インセクト$$ I've kept on standby!」

136:t_006:0.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「There are so many insect soldiers...!」

136:t_007:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I've identified the attack objective... I've confirmed the target...」

136:t_008:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That bastard! I thought he was slacking off, but he was on standby the whole time!」

136:t_009:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-Impossible! He wiped them all out in a single shot?!」

136:t_009:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Everything went exactly as $$ゼロ$$ planned. You were merely being played.」

136:t_009:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I deliberately created a weak front and made you commit all your remaining troops there...」

136:t_009:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then I positioned $$ヒイロ$$ there to wipe them out in one fell swoop. I predicted your every move to the very end, $$ギルター$$.」

136:t_009:4.en:
$$ゼクス$$
($$ゼロ$$ entrusted $$ヒイロ$$ with the key to his plan, and $$ヒイロ$$ trusted the plan and carried out his part...)

136:t_009:5.en:
$$ゼクス$$
(They share the bond of comrades who have overcome countless battles together.)

136:t_009:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You shot people from behind overwhelming strength without being prepared to be shot yourself. $c will strike you down!」

136:t_009:8.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, begin your attack! We'll overwhelm them in one push!」

136:t_010:0.en:
$n
「I'll cover you, $$ヒイロ$$! Let's finish this fast!」

136:t_011:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「Here I come, $$サイデリアル$$! I won't let you do whatever you please to $$トウキョウ$$!」

136:t_011:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ギルター・ベローネ$$! You will learn the fury of the people!」

136:t_012:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「I wondered how this would turn out at first, but we pulled through.」

136:t_012:2.en:
$$カトル$$
「Our commanders made the difference in this victory.」

136:t_012:3.en:
$$デュオ$$
「I'd like some praise for us too, for helping him pull it off.」

136:t_012:4.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Indeed. But we can't match $$玉城$$'s utterly convincing performance of anger.」

136:t_012:6.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「It looks like we'd better leave it at that.」

136:t_012:7.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Well... All's well that ends well.」

136:t_012:8.en:
$$カレン$$
($$シャーリー$$, $$ロロ$$... I managed to protect the place where your memories live...)

136:t_012:9.en:
$n
「Come to think of it, the school $$カレン$$ attended is in this city too, isn't it?」

136:t_012:10.en:
$$カレン$$
「It wasn't just me. $$スザク$$, $$ヒイロ$$, $$デュオ$$, $$沙慈$$... and $$ゼロ$$ went there too.」

136:t_012:11.en:
$$デュオ$$
「And that's not all. Miss $$リリーナ$$ and Deputy Foreign Minister $$ナナリー$$ graduated from there too.」

136:t_012:12.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「When you think about it, that's quite a lineup...」

136:t_012:13.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I see... So this is where $$沙慈$$ and $$ルイス$$ met.」

136:t_012:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That was a long time ago.」

136:t_012:16.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(But those memories made me who I am today.)

136:t_012:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
($$シャーリー$$, $$ロロ$$... I swear to you...)

136:t_012:18.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(I am $$ゼロ$$... I will bring about a miracle and restore peace to the world...)

136:t_013:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「$$ウイングゼロ$$ really owns the battlefield in this kind of fight.」

136:t_014:0.en:
$$トロワ$$
「The targets are silent. They are not returning fire.」

136:t_014:2.en:
$$トロワ$$
「The credit isn't mine. It's $$ヘビーアームズ$$'s power.」

136:t_015:1.en:
$$ノイン$$
「You wiped out only the enemy, keeping the city safe... That was impressive, $$ゼクス$$.」

136:t_015:2.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「This city's reconstruction has put $$ゼロ・レクイエム$$ in the past... That is precisely why I want to protect it.」
